description.text: The seventh expansion of the XY series, released on 20 June 2015, in which the mythical Pokémon Hoopa made its first appearance in the card game, a month before its film opened. Hoopa-EX's Ability brings three Pokémon-EX from the deck to the hand. M Tyranitar-EX and M Sceptile-EX brought new θ Ancient Traits, θ Double and θ Stop, and M Ampharos-EX, Giratina-EX, Lugia-EX, Machamp-EX and Kyurem-EX join them. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 81, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-EX and Ultra Rare cards: shiny Primal Kyogre-EX, Primal Groudon-EX and M Rayquaza-EX with the Ancient Trait θ Max, and gold Energy Retrieval and Trainers' Mail. In English most of its cards came out in Ancient Origins in August 2015, including the three shiny legends.
